about_the_game:
It’s time to explore new horizons!

Revisit the world of Bloopy & Droopy, this time through its rich, dynamic, and energetic soundtrack featuring a total of 21 chiptune 8-bit tracks that will instantly bring back your most nostalgic memories!

In addition, the soundtrack also includes 7 unused tracks that didn’t make it into the game, available in high-quality audio.

The soundtrack is composed by Ruddy Fantelli and is available in both .mp3 and .flac.
